2608.05139.title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning
2608.05139.paper_summary: Long-horizon reasoning in recent LLMs demands that the model switch between distinct skills inside a reasoning chain, such as first doing a math derivation, then using the result to plan a schedule. We call such problems cross-skill long-horizon tasks: multi-step tasks whose steps require different reasoning skills and depend on earlier outputs. Existing benchmarks often evaluate individual skills, lacking a principled way to measure how well a model switches between skills. We address this gap from both the evaluation and training sides. We introduce Skill Entropy, a measure of the difficulty of switching from one skill to another. We then propose Skill^2-Bench, a benchmark of cross-skill long-horizon tasks built over 558 skills across 9 verifiable and open-ended domains. Each task is assigned a task-level skill-entropy score and grouped into three difficulty levels. Evaluating 8 frontier and 4 open-source models on Skill^2-Bench reveals a skill-switching gap: accuracy decreases on higher-entropy tasks. We then turn skill entropy from a benchmark scale into a training signal. We propose Skill-Entropy RL, an RL framework where the model predicts not only the answer at each step but also the skill used to produce it. The reward combines step-level correctness with a skill-entropy reward that measures the alignment between the model-predicted skill sequence and the gold skill sequence. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Qwen3-1.7B, Skill-Entropy RL improves the Skill^2-Bench score from 34.4% to 68.4% and from 14.6% to 40.1%, respectively, outperforming competitive baselines. The same pipeline can be applied to off-the-shelf training data such as OpenR1-Math, indicating that skill entropy is a reusable training signal. Code available at: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Skill-Entropy-RL
2608.05139.paper_summary_zh: 長期推理在最近的LLM中要求模型在推理鏈內部切換不同的技能，例如首先進行數學推導，然後使用結果來計劃時間表。我們稱這類問題為跨技能長期任務：多步驟任務，其步驟需要不同的推理技能並依賴於早期的輸出。現有的基準通常評估單一技能，缺乏一種原則性的方法來衡量模型在技能之間切換的效果。我們從評估和訓練兩方面解決這一空白。我們引入了技能熵，這是一種衡量從一種技能切換到另一種技能的難度的指標。然後，我們提出了Skill^2-Bench，這是一個建立在9個可驗證和開放式領域中558種技能上的跨技能長期任務基準。每個任務被分配一個任務級別的技能熵分數，並分為三個難度級別。在Skill^2-Bench上評估8個前沿模型和4個開源模型揭示了技能切換的差距：在高熵任務上的準確性下降。我們然後將技能熵從基準尺度轉化為訓練信號。我們提出了Skill-Entropy RL，這是一個強化學習框架，其中模型不僅預測每一步的答案，還預測用於產生該答案的技能。獎勵結合了步驟級別的正確性和一個技能熵獎勵，該獎勵衡量模型預測的技能序列與金標技能序列之間的對齊程度。在Qwen3-4B-Instruct和Qwen3-1.7B上，Skill-Entropy RL將Skill^2-Bench的分數從34.4%提高到68.4%，從14.6%提高到40.1%，超越了競爭基準。同樣的流程可以應用於現成的訓練數據，例如OpenR1-Math，這表明技能熵是一個可重用的訓練信號。代碼可在此獲得：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Skill-Entropy-RL
